escenas.texto: Modo atardecer · Luces de piscina y lanai
escenas.prompt: Static camera. Dusk in the backyard. The man stands still at the grill seen from behind while light smoke rises. Midway, the underwater pool lights switch on by themselves and the water glows turquoise, and the warm lanai ceiling lights and the wall lantern turn on softly. Nothing else changes: same framing, same sky, same furniture. Soft click, grill sizzle.

Static camera, dusk by the lit pool. The pit bull lying on the dry pavers slowly turns his head toward the glowing turquoise pool water, looks at it curiously and wags his tail gently. He stays lying on the pavers and does not get up. In the background, the man at the grill stays out of focus, smoke rising. The pool water ripples softly. Water lapping, tail thumping on pavers.
The man grills on the lanai, seen from behind, both hands busy, smoke rising, pool lights glowing. Grill sizzle.
The lanai camera turns slowly toward the pool, its status light blinks. Soft beep.
